_comment: Canonical TrustedSigner document shape. client is the authority - it stores external L2 signer public keys for governance envelope signature verification. Used by the L4 Warden to verify multi-sig quorum on governed actions. A field mismatch breaks L2 governance and consensus quorum verification.
_consumers: client internal services (L4 Warden, governance verification)

trusted_signer._description: External L2 signer public key record. Each signer represents an enrolled agentic app that can participate in consensus consensus. Signer IDs correspond to ConsensusPolicy.MemberAppIDs.

id.description: Unique signer identifier (e.g. agent ID or app name). Referenced by ConsensusPolicy.MemberAppIDs.

public_key_hex.description: ED25519 public key in hex encoding. Used to verify governance envelope signatures.

enabled.description: Whether this signer is currently enabled for governance participation.

added_at.description: When the signer was enrolled (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).
